title: The Prediction App
question: 把今天“模糊预言碰上普通事情，看起来像说中了”的巧合线放进学校活动场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: At a school fair, I decided to try a prediction app. It said a relation of mine would be arriving soon. The moment I left the classroom, I would get a big surprise. As soon as I went outside, my mother hurried towards me. She said my cousin would be here in less than an hour. We had to go home to meet him. The prediction sounded mysterious, but it was just a funny coincidence.

options.scenario_zh: 说在学校活动上，我决定试一个 prediction app
